_comment: Pixels the complexion step must never touch, per outfit, even though they read as warm and chromatic enough to be skin. The masters are fixed-pose renders, so a box is exact here in a way a general detector could never be: each entry was read off a gridded crop of the frame (see _qc/grid-feet.png) and checked against the before/after diff. Boxes cover (a) pale footwear, whose colour sits inside skin's own colour envelope, and (b) patches of sweep that pick up a gown's bounce light under a hem, which is warm and chromatic but is backdrop. This file only ever REMOVES pixels from the tone region; it cannot add any, and make_tones.py gate T5 verifies that nothing inside a box changed.
_units: x0, y0, x1, y1 in master pixels, inclusive, 768x1376 frames
